notes: Read all 243 source lines before editing. useTripReplay is a non-visual, time-based trip-replay state machine (virtual clock scaled by a speed multiplier mapped onto a drive position timeline). It is pure React hooks + setInterval/clearInterval + Date/Number/Math arithmetic, all RN-available, so logic, state names, control names, timing constants, JSDoc and inline comments are ported 1:1; the only substantive change is the type-import source.
